info.description: Affinity API for software platforms connecting practices to the compounder network. A practice is the customer organization, a provider is an individual clinician or prescriber, and a location is a physical practice site. The API covers practice management, catalog discovery, prescription-order submission, fulfillment tracking, and webhooks.
info.title: Affinity API

get.description: Returns the platform organization and the current role.
Returns the subject, mode, and scopes for the API key.
Lists the catalog items that are eligible for the authenticated account and mode.
Lists reviewed shipping services eligible for a catalog item, destination, and API mode.

post.description: Creates a one-time, origin-bound Affinity Elements client secret. The platform API key must stay on the server.

get.description: Lists compounders available to the authenticated account, including approved invite-only relationships.

post.description: Creates a single-use Affinity Hosted workflow URL that expires after 15 minutes. The platform API key must stay on the server.
Creates a one-time Affinity Hosted URL where the mapped provider reviews and PIN-signs every prescription in one patient order. The provider PIN never reaches the platform.

Creates one patient order containing one or more unsigned prescription drafts. A platform API key cannot sign them; create a provider-bound order signing session next. Idempotency-Key and actor context are required.
Cancels an order before shipment. To correct an order, cancel it and create a replacement.
Creates a practice for the platform. Send Idempotency-Key when you retry the same request.

get.description: Returns one practice that belongs to the platform.

patch.description: Updates one practice that belongs to the platform. Send Idempotency-Key when you retry the same request.

get.description: Lists pending, active, and revoked platform membership grants.

post.description: Creates a pending role grant. The user must accept it in an Affinity Hosted launch before it becomes active.

patch.description: Changes a pending grant's role or revokes the grant.

get.description: Lists patients owned by one platform-managed practice in the current mode.

post.description: Creates or returns a synthetic or real patient by the platform's stable external ID. Idempotency-Key is required.

get.description: Returns one patient owned by the platform-managed practice.

patch.description: Updates one patient owned by the platform-managed practice.

get.description: Returns payment-method readiness for this practice in the current mode.

post.description: Starts Stripe card setup after the practice accepts the current off-session collection terms.
Finalizes a succeeded Stripe SetupIntent and makes its card the practice's primary payment method.

get.description: Lists roles available for a platform-managed practice.

post.description: Creates a custom role for a platform-managed practice.

delete.description: Deletes an unassigned custom role. Protected roles and roles with active assignments cannot be deleted.

patch.description: Updates a custom role for a platform-managed practice.

get.description: Lists the platform's provider-to-Affinity identity mappings in the current Test or Live mode.

post.description: Links your platform's provider identity to a clinician in Affinity. Store the returned pmap_ ID and use it as providerMappingId for component or hosted sessions. Creating a mapping does not assert prescribing authority.

get.description: Returns the provider mapping and its current verification state. Use the mapping's pmap_ ID when you create component or hosted sessions.

parameters.description: The provider mapping ID returned by POST /v1/provider-mappings.
parameters.name: providerMappingId

patch.description: Revokes a provider mapping and every component, hosted, and delegated session issued through it.

parameters.description: The provider mapping ID returned by POST /v1/provider-mappings.
parameters.name: providerMappingId

get.description: Lists platform-owned user records in the current Test or Live mode.

post.description: Creates or returns a user by the platform's stable external ID. Idempotency-Key is required.

get.description: Returns one platform-owned user in the current mode.

patch.description: Updates or deactivates a platform-owned user. Deactivation revokes grants and launch sessions, not the user's independent Affinity account.
